answer: Audits are recorded in hollow, queued in trellis, and atlas publishes the wait time. A farm of 218 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 27 identities per epoch. A farm of 4336 identities would post 1656 proofs and burn roughly 51 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
